title: Bookshelf Search (Binary Search)
hints: Keep a half-open range [lo, hi) that must contain the answer. Look at the middle; throw away the half that cannot contain it.
lower_bound_index: if sorted[mid] < x the answer is right of mid (lo = mid + 1), otherwise it is mid or left of it (hi = mid).
count_equal = (first index with value > x) - (first index with value >= x). std::lower_bound / std::upper_bound do exactly this.
isqrt: binary search the answer r. Do not compute mid * mid (it overflows for big n); compare mid <= n / mid instead.
